entities.name: Andrei Victorovich Gaponov-Grekhov

entities.summary: Andrei Viktorovich Gaponov-Grekhov was a Russian (Soviet) physicist, a Full Member of the USSR Academy of Sciences, the founder of the Institute of Applied Physics in Nizhny Novgorod, and its first director in 1976–2003.
